source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of erythroblastosis foetalis; the book's problem is a self-check with a drawn Punnett square (PDF 95-96).

blocks.text: Erythroblastosis foetalis janeen (foetus) ya naumolood (new-born) bachche ki haemolytic bimari hai, yaani aisi bimari jis mein RBCs toot jate hain. Yeh Rh-negative hamla (pregnant) maa aur Rh-positive janeen ke darmiyan Rh incompatibility (Rh ka na milna) se hoti hai.
